title: Noise action on an orthogonal component
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite orthonormal basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ that contains the constant-one function. For any number $n$ of coordinates, parameter $\rho\in[0,1]$, function $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and subset $S$ of the coordinates, applying the product noise operator with parameter $\rho$ to the orthogonal component of $f$ indexed by $S$ gives $\rho^{|S|}$ times that component.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$B$ is a finite orthonormal basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ containing the constant-one function
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
